findings.explanation: transfer subtracts cents before checking funds. Transferring 51 from a balance of 50 raises InsufficientFunds but leaves the source at -1, violating error atomicity. Check available funds before changing either balance.

test_insufficient_funds_changes_nothing only checks the exception, so it passes despite the source balance changing. Assert both balances remain (50, 7) after the error; also assert unchanged balances after the other rejected transfers.
